import gzip, numpy as np
header=None; X=[]
# stream compute sums for log1p normalized counts maybe load float32 2.4M x15=145MB OK
rows=[]
with gzip.open('sample.swap.atac.q1.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
    header=f.readline().strip().split('\\t')
    cols=header[3:]
    for i,line in enumerate(f):
        vals=np.fromstring('\\t'.join(line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')[3:]), sep='\\t', dtype=np.float32)
        rows.append(vals)
        # if i>100000: break
X=np.vstack(rows)
print('shape', X.shape)
lib=X.sum(axis=0)
Y=np.log1p(X/lib*1e6)
C=np.corrcoef(Y.T)
print('Pearson logCPM top pairs')
pairs=[]
for i in range(len(cols)):
 for j in range(i+1,len(cols)):
  pairs.append((C[i,j],cols[i],cols[j]))
for r,a,b in sorted(pairs, reverse=True)[:30]: print(f'{r:.4f} {a} {b}')
print('bottom')
for r,a,b in sorted(pairs)[:20]: print(f'{r:.4f} {a} {b}')
# Euclidean/correlation dendro maybe pca projections
# highly variable bins
var=Y.var(axis=1)
idx=np.argsort(var)[-50000:]
C2=np.corrcoef(Y[idx].T)
print('top HV pairs')
pairs=[]
for i in range(len(cols)):
 for j in range(i+1,len(cols)):
  pairs.append((C2[i,j],cols[i],cols[j]))
for r,a,b in sorted(pairs, reverse=True)[:30]: print(f'{r:.4f} {a} {b}')
print('bottom HV')
for r,a,b in sorted(pairs)[:20]: print(f'{r:.4f} {a} {b}')

import gzip, subprocess, urllib.parse, sys, os
from collections import defaultdict
# load local counts for chr1p_1 rows < 1M
local_bins=[]; local_counts={}
with gzip.open('sample.swap.atac.q1.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
    header=f.readline().rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    cols=header[3:]
    for line in f:
        p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if p[0]"'!='"'chr1p_1': break
        st=int(p[1]); en=int(p[2])
        if st>=1000000: break
        local_bins.append((st,en))
        vals=list(map(int,p[3:]))
        for c,v in zip(cols,vals):
            local_counts.setdefault(c,{})[(st,en)]=v
print('local bins',len(local_bins),local_bins[:3], local_bins[-1])
source_info={
'Bladder':('GSM8426940','GSM8426940_Axolotl_Bladder_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Brain':('GSM8426943','GSM8426943_Axolotl_Brain_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Cloaca':('GSM8426946','GSM8426946_Axolotl_Cloaca_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'GallBladder':('GSM8426949','GSM8426949_Axolotl_GallBladder_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Gill':('GSM8426952','GSM8426952_Axolotl_Gill_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Heart':('GSM8426953','GSM8426953_Axolotl_Heart_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Intestine':('GSM8426954','GSM8426954_Axolotl_Intestine_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Kidney':('GSM8426957','GSM8426957_Axolotl_Kidney_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Limb':('GSM8426960','GSM8426960_Axolotl_Limb_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Liver':('GSM8426963','GSM8426963_Axolotl_Liver_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Lung':('GSM8426966','GSM8426966_Axolotl_Lung_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Pancreas':('GSM8426967','GSM8426967_Axolotl_Pancreas_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Prostate':('GSE273356','GSE273356_Axolotl_Prostate_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Spleen':('GSM8426970','GSM8426970_Axolotl_Spleen_Fragments.bed.gz'),
'Stomach':('GSM8426973','GSM8426973_Axolotl_Stomach_Fragments.bed.gz'),
}

def get_counts(acc, fname, limit=1000000):
    url='https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/download/?acc=%s&format=file&file=%s' % (acc, urllib.parse.quote(fname))
    # shell handles broken pipe okay; use python streaming gzip? easier command gzip -dc pipe
    cmd=['bash','-lc', f\"set -o pipefail; curl -L --fail --silent {url"'!r} | gzip -dc"]
    proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
    counts=defaultdict(int)
    try:
        for line in proc.stdout:
            p=line.rstrip('"'\\n').split('\\t')
            if len(p)<3: continue
            chrom=p[0]; st=int(p[1]); en=int(p[2])
            if chrom"'!='"'chr1p_1' or st>=limit:
                break
            sbin=(st//10000)*10000
            ebin=((en-1)//10000)*10000
            for b in range(sbin, min(ebin,limit-1)+1, 10000):
                counts[(b,b+10000)] += 1
    finally:
        try: proc.kill()
        except Exception: pass
        proc.stdout.close()
        # don't wait too long
        try: proc.wait(timeout=5)
        except Exception: pass
    return counts

matches=[]
for s,(acc,fname) in source_info.items():
    sc=get_counts(acc,fname)
    diffs=[]
    for c in cols:
        # compare all local bins in region; source missing bins count zero
        mism=sum(1 for b in local_bins if sc.get(b,0)"'!=local_counts[c][b])
        absdiff=sum(abs(sc.get(b,0)-local_counts[c][b]) for b in local_bins)
        diffs.append((mism,absdiff,c))
    diffs.sort()
    print('"'SOURCE',s,'best',diffs[:5])
    matches.append((s,diffs[0]))
print('summary')
for s,(m,a,c) in matches:
    print(f'{s:12s} -> {c:12s} mism={m} abs={a}')

import gzip, subprocess, urllib.parse
from collections import defaultdict
limit=10000000
cols=None; local_bins=[]; local_counts={}
with gzip.open('sample.swap.atac.q1.tsv.gz','rt') as f:
    cols=f.readline().rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')[3:]
    want={'Cloaca','Stomach'}
    for line in f:
        p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        if p[0]"'!='"'chr1p_1': break
        st=int(p[1]); en=int(p[2])
        if st>=limit: break
        b=(st,en); local_bins.append(b)
        vals=list(map(int,p[3:]))
        for c,v in zip(cols,vals):
            if c in want: local_counts.setdefault(c,{})[b]=v

def stream(acc,fname):
    url='https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/download/?acc=%s&format=file&file=%s'%(acc,urllib.parse.quote(fname))
    proc=subprocess.Popen(['bash','-lc',f\"curl -L --fail --silent {url"'!r} | gzip -dc"],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
    counts=defaultdict(int)
    for line in proc.stdout:
        p=line.rstrip('"'\\n').split('\\t')
        if len(p)<3: continue
        chrom=p[0]; st=int(p[1]); en=int(p[2])
        if chrom"'!='"'chr1p_1' or st>=limit: break
        s=(st//10000)*10000; e=((en-1)//10000)*10000
        for x in range(s,min(e,limit-1)+1,10000): counts[(x,x+10000)]+=1
    proc.kill()
    return counts
for name,acc,fname in [
    ('source_Cloaca','GSM8426946','GSM8426946_Axolotl_Cloaca_Fragments.bed.gz'),
    ('source_Stomach','GSM8426973','GSM8426973_Axolotl_Stomach_Fragments.bed.gz')]:
    sc=stream(acc,fname)
    print(name, 'bins', len(local_bins))
    for col in ['Cloaca','Stomach']:
        mism=sum(sc.get(b,0)"'!=local_counts[col][b] for b in local_bins)
        absdiff=sum(abs(sc.get(b,0)-local_counts[col][b]) for b in local_bins)
        print('"'  vs',col,'mism',mism,'abs',absdiff)
